setup.title: Welcome to WDP

header.deleteConfirm:
Delete profile "{name}"?

This removes it from WDP. Generated files in your project folder are NOT deleted.

settings.webhookDesc: Trigger a deployment from GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or any system that can make an HTTP request.
settings.tokenWarning: ⚠ Store this token securely — it is not shown again after regeneration.

step2.subtitle: Describe the server your app will run on.

git.initBody: Creates a git repository in your Wappler project folder, adds WDP-safe .gitignore rules (secrets stay local), and optionally commits generated wdp/ files. Further git features in WDP are coming later.
git.initFirstCommit: Create first commit for wdp/ files (if any exist)
git.initSuccess: Git is ready for this project.
git.initAlreadyRepo: Project was already a git repository — .gitignore refreshed
git.initRemoteHint: Further commits, diffs, and GitHub push will come in a later WDP release.
git.repoActiveBody: This project already has git. WDP Phase A only covers initial setup.
git.comingSoonNote: Coming later in WDP: diff, commit wdp/ files, deploy tags, and GitHub integration.

knowledge.title: Project Knowledge
knowledge.subtitle: Generate a knowledge base from your project source files for use with the AI assistant.
knowledge.notGeneratedHint: Click "Generate knowledge" to analyse your project.

ai.title: AI Assistant
ai.noKey: No OpenRouter API key set. Add one in Settings.

settings.title: Settings
settings.openrouterKeyHint: Get a key at openrouter.ai — it is stored on the server and never sent to the browser.

staleGenerate.title: Регенерирайте файловете за внедряване
staleGenerate.bodyChanged: Настройките в съветника са променени след последното генериране на Docker файлове (стъпка 8). Регенерирайте Dockerfile.deploy, docker-compose.deploy.yml и .env.deploy преди внедряване.
staleGenerate.bodyNever: Все още не сте генерирали файловете за внедряване. Завършете стъпка 8 преди първото внедряване.
staleGenerate.bodyMissing: Генерираните файлове липсват в папката на проекта. Отворете стъпка 8 и ги регенерирайте.
